purpose: Further reduce execution time through equivalent native text loops, measuring only the incremental gain over the already released native v0.8.0.
candidate_scope: literal excerpt occurrence collection if differential tests and diagnostics support it
frozen_semantics: Database schema, SQL, candidate limits, ranking, tie order and project isolation
Normalization order, Unicode code-point indexing, source spans and public payloads
Identifier token order, frequency, query aliasing and dynamic helper behavior
Segmentation, stable IDs, budgets, cross-call caches and MIT license

formal_requirements.timing_boundary: Direct recall or actual official-SDK stdio MCP roundtrip, excluding model generation
identity: both compiled binaries and build logs
query order and full attempt ledgers
formal_requirements.equality: Complete indexed/source contents and per-query payloads including exact source coordinates; exclude only the predeclared nondeterministic timestamp and latency fields
formal_requirements.evidence: Keep every started attempt and completed round; save raw reports, frozen auditor and compiled binaries to a dedicated Git evidence ref automatically
formal_requirements.acceptance: Exact differential and end-to-end equality, repeatable primary improvement without a material unexplained regression, exact-commit CI and verified native-wheel delivery are required for default adoption
formal_requirements.reporting: Report incremental results against v0.8.0 separately from earlier Python-to-native gains; retain regressions and resource costs
